explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/452: what is the size of the largest interval I ⊆ [x,2x] with ω(n) > log log n for all n ∈ I? `largeOmegaIntervalLength x` is the largest len with an interval [start, start+len) ⊆ [x, 2x] on which ω(n) > log log n, capped at x+1, which is the length of [x,2x]. That definition is correct. The statement asks for this function exactly (equality with an unknown ℕ → ℕ). The source plainly seeks asymptotic information: the page cites the CRT lower bound (1+o(1))log x/(log log x)² and the possibility of (log x)^k. So the exact-equality form is a much stronger, less natural reading of the question than an asymptotic one.
